title: Nottingham Forest F.C. — Coach Development help centre
lead: Two tools come with coaching here. The learning platform — the Forest game model, alongside masterclasses and on-the-grass sessions from some of the best coaches in the game. And Session Planner — where you build a session, animate it, and send it to your players before they reach the ground. Here is how to get the most out of both.

sections.title: Getting in
sections.lead: If you have not been into the platform yet, or you cannot get in today, start here. Everything below it is reference you can use at any time, without signing in.

steps.p: You will get an email from Coaches’ Voice inviting you to the Nottingham Forest platform. Open it, click Accept invitation and set your own password.
steps.small: Nothing in your inbox? Check your junk folder first, then email {{supportEmail}} and we will resend it.

steps.p: From then on you log in at {{lmsHost}} with your email and the password you just set. Worth bookmarking it.
steps.small: Forgotten it? Use Forgot password on the login screen — the reset email arrives in a couple of minutes.

p: Start with Nottingham Forest Introduction Video — the club’s history and what it means to coach here, followed by eleven questions.
If you coach in the Youth Development Phase or above, move on to The 4 moments, our game model.

item.q: What is the difference between “The 4 moments” and “Game Model: Reference”?
a:
• The 4 moments is the one you complete. It walks you through all four moments — In Possession, Transition to Defend, Out of Possession, Transition to Attack — and their pitch maps. Clips cannot be skipped, a pitch map only unlocks as complete once every clip on it has been watched, and the module is only finished when all seventy clips are done.
  • Game Model: Reference is the one you come back to. The same eight pitch maps, grouped into In Possession, Out of Possession and Transitions, with no locks and no order. Jump straight to the clip you want, skip through it, close it.
They track separately. Dipping into the reference maps will not move your progress on the learning module, and it will not show up in anyone’s report.
The way to think about it: complete The 4 moments once, then live in Reference week to week.

sections.note: Build it, animate it, send it to your players
sections.lead: Build a session, animate it in 3D so your players see the movement rather than read a diagram, and send it to them before they get to the ground. Next week, adapt it instead of starting again. It is a separate platform from your learning one, with its own login.

sections.title: Still stuck?
sections.lead: Email {{supportEmail}}. Tell us your name, the module or session you were in and what you saw on screen — it gets you an answer far quicker. Anything about the Forest content itself, speak to your Academy contact.
